description: One signed publish request, as workers/stock_scanner/app_client.py signs it and src/lib/updates/publish-auth.ts verifies it: HMAC-SHA256 over '<timestamp>.<body>' with the shared secret, sent as 'x-lyra-signature: t=<timestamp>,v1=<hex>'. Both sides' tests compute the signature from this file and must agree with it. The secret here is a test value, never a real one.
